text:
Alex M: paging: SRE alert for spike in 5xx from our API gateway, started ~16:42 UTC. Dashboard shows error rate to /v1/generate up to 18%
Nora S: seeing the same, errors are mostly downstream 502/503 gateway errors, latency also up ~3x
Ivy (oncall): I'm on it, grabbing logs. Any deploys or config rollouts in last 30m?
DeployBot: deploy redwood/gateway 2026-03-15T16:30Z canary -> traffic=10% (author: kevinl)
Kevin L: I rolled a canary earlier that updated Envoy per-route retry policy for egress clusters (added `retry_on: 5xx,gateway-error`), only to EU and CA egress.
Alex M: that matches the error geography — EU region showing biggest spike. Can you confirm which route got the change?
Kevin L: route `external-eu` and `external-ca` had `max_retries: 2` + `retry_on` added in the canary; I also lowered circuit_breaker thresholds to limit bursts (max_connections: 50) while testing.
Nora S: lowering CB + retries = recipe for retry storms. If upstream is transiently failing, retries will multiply traffic and trip CBs -> cascade 5xx.
Ivy (oncall): impact: ~7% of customers reporting slow or failed generation calls, SLO error budget burning. I've flagged customer-facing ops.
Alex M: immediate mitigation options: 1) remove retry_on/disable retries via runtime flag 2) increase CB thresholds 3) shift canary back to previous config 4) route traffic away from egress cluster.
Ivy (oncall): I'll escalate to platform-eng and start a rollback of the canary to previous gateway config. Rolling back canary now: `kubectl -n gateway apply -f gateway-config@previous` (running)
Kevin L: ack. I'll prepare a runtime patch to disable retries in Envoy: `runtime_specs: envoy.reloadable_flags.disable_retries=true`
DeployBot: rollback started (canary traffic -> 0%, previous config -> green)
Alex M: while rollback proceeds, can we also raise circuit breaker thresholds so currently open connections don't get rejected? Command to change config: `PATCH /v1/admin/runtime` with payload `{"cluster.external-eu.max_connections": 500}`
Nora S: I'll apply that via the control plane. Doing `curl -X POST https://gateway-admin.svc/runtime -d 'cluster.external-eu.max_connections=500'`
Ivy (oncall): paging customer success to prepare a status note. CS: @cs-team FYI customers in EU may see elevated 5xx for last ~45m, mitigation underway
Alex M: logs show these traces:```
ERROR upstream reset: code=503 cluster=external-eu host=10.12.8.4:443, attempt=1
retrying request -> new upstream connection
upstream response 502 after retry
```
Kevin L: that confirms retry loop. Once rollback finishes, we should see error rates drop. Also we should add a guard in rollout process: don't lower CB thresholds when enabling retries.
Ivy (oncall): rollback finished at 16:57 UTC per DeployBot. Monitoring now.
DeployBot: rollback complete, canary traffic set to 0% (2026-03-15T16:57:12Z)
Nora S: immediate metrics: overall 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 4% in 4m, latency trending down. Still some tail errors as upstream recovers.
Alex M: Customer impact note: affected customers include orgs with EU endpoints, estimated 10-12 tenants saw >2% error rate. CS should send an advisory.
Ivy (oncall): CS drafted message, linking to monitoring. Also creating a post-incident action item to: revert risky config changes in canary policy, add automated check preventing retries + low CB thresholds, and add canary blast radius limit.
Kevin L: action: open PR to add guard rails in our rollout job, include a linter that rejects changes that reduce CB thresholds in the same diff as enabling retries. I'll own the PR.
Alex M: also create a playbook entry: if retry rate spikes after config change, immediately disable retries runtime flag before full rollback, to reduce blast radius.
Ivy (oncall): filing incident ticket: INC-2026-0315-01, root cause: canary Envoy config introduced retries + lowered circuit breaker thresholds, causing retry amplification and upstream overload.
Nora S: adding monitoring alert tuned: if per-cluster retry_attempts per_min > X and cb_tripped_rate > Y -> auto-notify platform oncall and block rollout.
Alex M: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Kevin PR + runtime flag docs, Nora update monitoring, CS customer comms, postmortem + timeline. I'll be owner for the postmortem.
Ivy (oncall): handing back to normal channel, mark resolved for paging. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-0315-01 created, severity=sev2, assignees=[Alex M, Ivy (oncall), Kevin L, Nora S]
